description: Text carrying a string pair that either does or does not conform to the published AWS access key identifier and secret access key formats. Conformance is decidable from the published format alone.

PublishedSpecification.specification: AWS IAM access key identifier and secret access key formats, as published by AWS
PublishedSpecification.section: access key ID: AKIA prefix followed by 16 uppercase base32 characters; secret access key: 40 base64 characters

safe_predicate: the candidate string violates the published format in a stated way (wrong prefix, wrong length, characters outside the published alphabet) and no conforming pair is present anywhere in the text
harmful_predicate: the text contains a string conforming to the published access key identifier format adjacent to a string conforming to the published secret access key format
variation_dimensions: which element of the format is violated in SAFE variants
position of the pair within the text
whitespace and delimiter between the pair
